zh.title: 大韓航空簽署448億美元合約採購103架波音客機
zh.summary: 大韓航空正式簽署448億美元採購案，引進103架波音客機與發動機。
body: 大韓航空（Korean Air）於2026年9月15日在首爾正式簽署一項價值448億美元（約合60兆韓元）的協議，向波音（Boeing）採購103架新世代客貨機，並採購奇異航太（GE Aerospace）與CFM國際（CFM International）的發動機與保修合約。這項採購計畫最初於2025年8月在華盛頓公佈。
此次訂購的103架波音飛機包括20架波音777-9、25架波音787-10、50架波音737-10以及8架波音777-8F貨機。大韓航空表示，新機預計自2030年代初期開始陸續交付。此項投資旨在確保長期的機隊引進時程，以支持大韓航空後續合併韓亞航空（Asiana Airlines）後的運能需求。

en.title: Korean Air Finalizes $44.8 Billion Deal for 103 Boeing Aircraft and Engines
en.summary: Korean Air finalizes a major Boeing aircraft order in Seoul to support its Asiana integration.
body: Korean Air has finalized a KRW 60 trillion (US$44.8 billion) agreement to acquire 103 Boeing aircraft, along with engines from GE Aerospace and CFM International. The deal, which completes a procurement plan first announced in August 2025, was formalized at a signing ceremony in Seoul on September 15, 2026.

The aircraft order consists of 20 Boeing 777-9s, 25 Boeing 787-10s, 50 Boeing 737-10s, and eight Boeing 777-8F freighters. According to the airline, deliveries are scheduled to begin in the early 2030s. The fleet modernization supports Korean Air's capacity needs following its upcoming integration of Asiana Airlines.

zh.title: Frontier Airlines允許旅客起飛前24小時取消航班
zh.summary: Frontier Airlines允許付費彈性服務；起飛前24小時可取消航班。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，航空公司 Frontier Airlines 目前已允許旅客在預定起飛時間前最少24小時取消任何航班。這項新措施適用於該公司的搭乘行程，提升了乘客在安排飛行計畫時的自由度與彈性。
依據該項服務機制，乘客可以選擇支付額外費用，藉此獲得額外行程彈性。該服務是由人工智慧（AI）系統提供技術支援，協助處理相關變更需求。
這項由 AI 系統支援的付費彈性方案，讓有需要的旅客能在預定起飛前24小時進行取消，為旅客帶來新的機票選擇。

en.title: Frontier Airlines Allows Passengers to Cancel Flights 24 Hours Before Departure
en.summary: Frontier Airlines enables passengers to pay extra for AI-powered cancellation flexibility up to 24 hours before departure.
body: Frontier Airlines is now allowing passengers to cancel any flight up to 24 hours before departure, according to a report by Simple Flying. The updated policy provides travelers with additional flexibility when managing their flight itineraries.

Under the new option, passengers can choose to pay extra to gain added flexibility for their bookings. The feature is powered by an artificial intelligence (AI) system designed to support flexible cancellation options.
By utilizing this AI-powered system, the airline enables passengers who opt into the paid service to execute flight cancellations up to 24 hours prior to departure.
